title: Conditions in Government Contracts that Encourage Environmental, Social and Governance Practices
what_it_is: Conditions in Government Contracts that Encourage Environmental, Social and Governance Practices

sections.label: Public sector green procurement
sections.summary: Government agencies buy energy-efficient equipment and green-labelled paper, and new large public buildings must meet Green Mark Platinum standards.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: For example, Government agencies practise green procurement by purchasing information and communications technology equipment and electrical appliances that meet energy efficiency standards, and printing paper that are environmentally friendly; they are certified with the Singapore Green Label.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: All new public sector buildings with more than 5,000 square metres of air-conditioned floor area are required to attain Green Mark Platinum standards.

sections.label: Industrial energy and water reporting
sections.summary: Large industrial energy consumers must track and report energy use and emissions annually, and industrial water consumers must report water use and submit plans.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: Large industrial energy consumers are required to track and report their energy usage, including greenhouse gas emissions annually.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: Similarly, industrial and business water consumers need to track and report their water usage annually and submit Water Efficiency Management Plans.

sections.label: SGX sustainability reporting
sections.summary: Since 2016 the Singapore Exchange requires publicly-listed companies to report sustainability on a comply-or-explain basis, with sustainability indices to guide them.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: Since 2016, the Singapore Exchange has implemented sustainability reporting for all publicly-listed companies on a "comply or explain" basis, and it has a number of sustainability indices to guide listed companies.

sections.label: Green financing and inclusive hiring schemes
sections.summary: MAS and the Ministry work on green financing for ESG lending, while the Special Employment Credit and Partnership Scheme support disability hiring and volunteerism.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: The Monetary Authority of Singapore and the Ministry of the Environment and Water Resources have been working on green financing initiatives to encourage the Financial Institutions to adopt more ESG considerations in their lending and investment decisions.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: The Special Employment Credit supports inclusive hiring of Persons with Disabilities, through offsetting their wages.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: The Business and Institutions of a Public Character Partnership Scheme encourages employee volunteerism through the provision of 250% tax deduction on qualifying expenditure for businesses.
